main.description: Get a subject belonging to the authenticated account, including its moderation action history from this moderation service.

did.description: Account to preview. Defaults to the authenticated account; another account requires an active moderator, triage, or admin credential.

subject.description: DID or AT-URI of the subject to retrieve.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No subject was found, or the authenticated account does not own the subject.
